decisions.reason: As a devoré decoration fabric close to the existing range, it fits the firm's related knowledge and feedback-based selling model, although collection fashion risk and no visible R&D signal leave a moderate withdrawal chance.

This transparent burnout decorative fabric is still near the firm's core decorative textile competence, but its more style-sensitive niche raises the chance of assortment replacement despite the firm's ability to learn from customers.
Because burnout decorative fabric is closely related to the firm's established offer, management can interpret demand and refine the product, though decorative collections are periodically refreshed.
A velour-like upholstery fabric builds directly on the firm's upholstery textile know-how and service strengths, so absorptive capacity argues for continuation rather than exit.
The flame-retardant plain inbetween fabric is a functional extension of the existing portfolio that the firm can support well with its current knowledge, stocking, and customer relationships.

The polyester lining fabric with satin sheen is a familiar adjacent product that suits the firm's warehousing and reorder continuity model, though it could still be trimmed if management simplifies the range.
